prompt: Medium shot, 23-year-old East Asian woman, delicate profile, natural skin texture, hair falling loosely over one shoulder. Oversized white shirt worn open over the lavender-grey lace set, standing by a bedroom window at dusk adjusting her sleeve, vertical 3:4 composition with subject positioned to one side, window view softly blurred behind her. Soft blue-hour light through the window mixing with a faint warm interior lamp glow, gentle rim light along her arm. Photographic texture and quality: subtle ISO 400 film grain in shadow areas, natural subsurface skin scattering, faint hair flyaways caught by the window draft. Preserve: lace pattern, window light quality. Avoid: AI-smoothed skin, artificially perfect symmetry.

promptZh: 中景镜头，23 岁东亚女性，精致侧颜，自然皮肤质感，长发松散地垂在一侧肩头。外搭一件敞开的超大号白衬衫，内穿薰衣草灰蕾丝套装，站在卧室窗边，于 黄昏 时分整理袖口，3:4 竖构图，主体位于画面一侧，窗外景色呈现柔和虚化。窗外柔和的蓝调时刻光线与室内微弱的暖色台灯光交织，手臂边缘呈现柔和的轮廓光。摄影质感与质量：阴影区域带有细微的 ISO 400 胶片颗粒感，自然的皮肤次表面散射，窗边微风吹动细碎的发丝。保留：蕾丝纹理、窗户光影质量。避免：AI 磨皮感、人工合成的完美对称。
